snippet.title: Electronic Popple gameplay (PC Game, 1997)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Electronic Popple, Dos PC game produced by Capcom in 1997 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/electronic-popple/1392/
Playing the first two levels of this nice platform game. The environment is the internal part of a computer..
